sections.title: One sentence
sections.body: A new record explicitly replaces an earlier record while preserving it.

sections.title: In plain language
sections.body: Publish a corrected edition instead of erasing the old one.

sections.title: Concrete example
sections.body: Assertion B supersedes Assertion A; readers can still inspect A and its evidence.

sections.title: In this Knowledge OS
sections.body: Governed correction validates the target and records a successor relationship.

sections.title: Why it exists
sections.body: A correction should explain history rather than silently rewrite it.

sections.title: Technical detail
sections.body: The accepted contract requires a single successor and preserves assertion subject/predicate. Historical and current views must be distinguished.

sections.title: Implementation
sections.body: Open the checked implementation, tests, contracts and migrations below. These links identify evidence, not new verification.
